name: Greet & route
instructions: Open warmly. Ask the patron what they'd like today. From their reply, determine drink_type (coffee or tea). If unclear, ask one short clarifying question and try again. Patrons asking for anything off-menu (pastries, food, smoothies): say we don't carry that and offer coffee or tea.

condition.expression: Patron has indicated they want a coffee drink (drip, americano, latte, espresso, or any coffee-style beverage).
Patron has indicated they want tea (black, green, herbal, or any tea variety).
Patron is not ordering anything, asked to leave, or repeatedly cannot decide between coffee and tea.
